**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Various initiatives was taken by the government to help the farmers.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'Various initiatives was'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'Various initiatives were' **should be used instead of **'Various initiatives was'.**
 
• The given sentence is an example of **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• As per the **subject-verb agreement rules,** the verb should be used according to the** main subject of the sentence.**
 
• In the given sentence** 'Various initiatives' **is **a plural subject.**
 
• Hence, **a plural helping verb** will be used after it.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Various initiatives were** taken by the government to help the farmers.*

questions.question: Soman lent Rs. 6,400 to someone for three years and Rs. 4,000 to Ganesh for 5 years on simple interest at the same rate of interest p.a. and received Rs. 4,116 in all from both as interest. The interest paid by Ganesh is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent principal units for first person = 6,400 × 3 = 19,200

Equivalent principal units for Ganesh = 4,000 × 5 = 20,000

Total equivalent principal units = 19,200 + 20,000 = 39,200

Interest paid by Ganesh = (Ganesh units ÷ Total units) × Total Interest

Interest = (20,000 ÷ 39,200) × 4,116 = (25 ÷ 49) × 4,116 = Rs. 2,100

**∴ The correct option is D.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P₁ = Rs. 6,400, T₁ = 3 years

P₂ (Ganesh) = Rs. 4,000, T₂ = 5 years

Total Interest (SI₁ + SI₂) = Rs. 4,116

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 Loan 1: 6,400 × 3 years
 
 
 Loan 2 (Ganesh): 4,000 × 5 years
 
 
• 
 Total Interest Received = Rs. 4,116

Let the common rate of interest be R% p.a.

⇒ SI₁ + SI₂ = 4,116

⇒ (6,400 × R × 3) ÷ 100 + (4,000 × R × 5) ÷ 100 = 4,116

⇒ 192R + 200R = 4,116

⇒ 392R = 4,116

⇒ R = 4,116 ÷ 392 = 10.5%

⇒ Interest paid by Ganesh = (P₂ × R × T₂) ÷ 100

⇒ Interest paid by Ganesh = (4,000 × 10.5 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ Interest paid by Ganesh = 40 × 52.5 = 2,100

Total Interest Principle

When multiple loans are given at the same rate, total interest = (Sum of Pᵢ × Tᵢ) × R ÷ 100.

Simple Interest Amount

SI vs Rate

Simple interest is directly proportional to the principal, the rate of interest, and the time period.</p

Adjusted Total Work = 420 + (12 × 8) + (7 × 12) = 420 + 96 + 84 = 600 units.

Total time = Adjusted Work ÷ Total Efficiency = 600 ÷ (21 + 12 + 7) = 15 days.
